service-about: Manage the native background session service.
service-user-required: Specify the regular service account with --username.
service-password-required: Set the service account password in environment variable {{.environment}}.
service-user-mismatch: The service account must match the user who owns the terminal sessions.
service-system-account-rejected: Terminal services require a regular user account; built-in system accounts are not supported.
service-root-rejected: Run the terminal service as a regular user, not root.
service-stop-timeout: Timed out stopping the terminal service and its session processes.
service-unsupported-platform: Native terminal services are supported on Windows and Linux.
service-flag-name: service name or isolated instance name
service-flag-username: regular Windows account that owns the sessions
service-flag-password-env: environment variable containing the service account password
service-install-login: User service installed. Start it for this login with {{.tool}} service start.
service-windows-account-required: Specify a regular Windows service account with --username and provide its password through --password-env.
